entities.summary: Stram Kurs, is a far-right, nationalist, anti-Islam political party in Denmark and Sweden founded in 2017 by Danish-Swedish lawyer Rasmus Paludan. The party is almost exclusively associated with its founder and his anti-Islam activism and demonstrations. Stram Kurs is a political party in Europe, established in 2017-03-16.
